name: St. Croix River — Lower
gaugeName: ST. CROIX RIVER AT ST. CROIX FALLS, WI
blurb: The St. Croix below the Taylors Falls / St. Croix Falls dam between Wisconsin-side public landings.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

notices.title: Portage information
notices.text: St. Croix Falls / Taylors Falls hydroelectric dam: NPS river map: "There is a 3.1 mile portage around the dam … through Taylors Falls, Minnesota." The upper and lower St. Croix reaches are separate catalog rivers; no section crosses the dam.
notices.sourceName: NPS St. Croix NSR — river map 7

putInAccess.operator: Interstate State Park (ownership 'Wisconsin DNR' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency-listed access area; the marker does not identify the exact water-edge landing. Confirm the signed approach and current access conditions with the site manager. DNR notes that non-DNR sites in this inventory are not actively maintained.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public approach to Interstate State Park Boat Ramp. The map shows the access area; find the designated landing on arrival and check current site conditions.

takeOutAccess.accessType: Boat ramp (WDNR boat access 'RAMP'), ramp type Concrete Plank
takeOutAccess.operator: NPS Visitor Center (ownership 'Federal' in the WDNR record)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency coordinate at the river-edge landing clearing, reached from the east-bank access road. Agency record and satellite imagery reviewed together on 2026-11-01. This is a desktop review, not a field survey. Check current signs and conditions. DNR does not actively maintain non-DNR records.

mapAuditNote: Access areas reviewed against current agency records. Exact water-edge landings have not been established for every endpoint; sections with unresolved permission or dam/portage questions are held separately.
